hv_done_k: The block reward halved at epoch {e} on {d}.
hv_err: Could not reach the CKB node.
hv_share_txt: The next CKB halving is expected on {date}, {n} days from now. {url}
hv_note: Estimated live from the chain: the average epoch time over the last 1,000 epochs, plus the time left in the current epoch.
hv_sched_p: The reward halves at every halving. Each bar is the daily base reward, drawn to scale.
hv_blk_note: Block reward is calculated at 1,800 blocks per epoch.
hv_what_p: A halving cuts the rate at which new CKB is issued to miners. The block reward drops by half on a fixed schedule.
hv_why_p: It makes issuance predictable. New supply follows a decaying curve instead of an open-ended one, which is one of the main differences from fiat money.
hv_how2_p: Base issuance rewards miners and halves about every 4 years, until all 33.6 billion base-issuance CKB is mined. Time is counted in epochs of about 4 hours, so every halving lands on a fixed epoch number.
hv_infl_n: It keeps falling toward 0% with every halving.
hv_rew_h: A block reward has four parts
hv_rew_p: The schedule above covers the base issuance only.
